title: Impact of Unenhanced Computed Tomography (CT) in Elderly Patients Admitted to the Emergency Department With Acute Abdominal Pain
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether non-contrast abdominal computed tomography (CT) impacts management (diagnosis, need for surgery and treatment) in elderly patients admitted to the emergency department with abdominal pain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Elderly patients admitted to the emergency department (aged 75 year old and older)
* acute abdominal pain
* informed consent

Exclusion criteria:

* traumatic pain
* symptom duration of more than a week
* unability for the patient to give informed consent
